details:
A new UI was never really needed, especially not whatever this is- but if you're going to commit to this, at least give us the option to keep and go back to current UI. The current UI is perfectly fine, it's plain, it's clear, it's understandable and isn't clogging up the screen at all. 

The additional on-screen bindings i don't think are even necessary at all since most things that aren't shown via tutorial (which seems to be what this new UI is intended for -- new players.) are typically shown through the loading screen with the scrolling tips.

The main things that bother me about this new UI is: 

The face mirror is inverted (I'm sure this isn't intended)

The mic icon is bothersome to have in the very corner rather than bottom left-ish where it's easy to see in your peripheral vision- having it in the very top right corner isn't very intuitive and is cumbersome/tedious/annoying to look at, especially with ultrawide monitors. 

The lack of actually being able to customize and move these around makes it worse as well, would make it better if flexible options for adjustments were added.

The notifications being at the top instead of the bottom is... weird and i think makes them worse as a whole- keep them at the bottom or make it movable if continuing with this new UI.

I don't see what the point of having the tooltips be on the mid-right side of your screen when the tooltips are shown on the object you're holding/pointed at, the only times i can see that being useful is if you're hovering over something that is far enough away from you to where you can't read the tooltips on the object itself.

The new keyboard is literally just a phone keyboard but taken into 3D space, current design is better, less tedious and overall fine.

Not a fan.
title: [1912] New HUD/UI is... questionable.
